data.name: Logix Artemis PRO Professional CAD — Autodesk AutoCAD 1.0

introduced.event_name: COMDEX November 1982 — Logix and Autodesk professional CAD presentation

data.status: Accepted COMDEX presentation and commercial offering; shipment follows hardware/software acceptance.
data.description: A jointly demonstrated professional CAD configuration combining Artemis PRO, the November professional graphics revision, Mono Pro 17, Logix Mouse and independently licensed Autodesk AutoCAD.

configuration.host: Artemis PRO, 1 MiB reference configuration, AIONix and qualified disk storage; final application minimum measured with representative drawings.
configuration.storage: Standard 5 MB disk is not promised sufficient for every CAD workload. Quote a tested storage/backup configuration; do not invent a larger shipping accessory.
configuration.professional_display: 128 KiB professional card with separate 1 KiB sprite SRAM and Ball HD17H-based analog Mono Pro 17; use dated revision effective 1982-11-29.
configuration.secondary_display: COMDEX reference station includes the existing 64 KiB card and Color Pro 14 for commands/status. Upgrade buyers may retain a compatible existing primary card/display.
configuration.software: One separately identified Autodesk AutoCAD 1.0 Artemis/AIONix licence. Do not imply Logix ownership, a free licence, or later AutoCAD features.
configuration.pointing: One Logix Mouse; typed coordinates remain available for numerical precision. Explicit Autodesk mouse and dual-display integration.
configuration.output: Demonstrate a qualified pen plotter with a documented driver; plotter is optional and separately quoted. No unselected model is represented as bundled.

commercial_routes.name: Complete professional CAD configuration
commercial_routes.basis: One host, one primary display/card, one professional display/card, one mouse and one AutoCAD licence. Remove/credit replaced base-system parts in the actual quote; never charge two primary cards.

commercial_routes.name: Existing Artemis professional upgrade
commercial_routes.basis: November professional card, Mono Pro 17 and AutoCAD licence; add mouse only if needed. Verify RAM, OS, slot, storage and primary display compatibility before quoting.

data.pricing: Dated November planning prices: comdex_1982_cost_review.json. Hardware at 25% net-contribution fallback; Autodesk licence uses a provisional $1000 historical anchor. Autodesk cost/channel terms remain unknown.

support_split.logix: Hardware, AIONix integration, drivers, installation and dealer coordination.
support_split.autodesk: AutoCAD licence, application support and drawing-file compatibility.
support_split.joint: Reference configuration testing, dealer training and escalation; define response commitments before quoting service.

acceptance: Run the agreed release-quality native AutoCAD build on the reference configuration
Load/save and exchange a representative drawing; verify numerical geometry
Use both displays and the mouse with correct focus and cursor restoration
Show readable antialiased lines and stable display refresh under accelerator load
Plot a physical drawing and verify scale and geometry
Recover from interrupted work and restore a backup
Document supported features; no automatic later-version dimensioning, object-snap or 3D claims
data.timeline: June remains initial hardware availability and Autodesk development handover. November 29 is the public joint CAD offering and expanded professional-card presentation, not a rewrite of June history.
